description: This file contains test cases for a FastAPI application, utilizing pytest and the FastAPI TestClient. It dynamically imports application modules based on parameters, tests various HTTP GET requests and response expectations including headers and schema validation.

classes.name: TestClient
classes.description: FastAPI's test client for making HTTP requests to the application during tests

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Fixture that imports a module dynamically and creates a TestClient instance for it

methods.name: test(path, headers, expected_status, expected_response, client: TestClient)
methods.description: Runs a parameterized test to make GET requests and check responses

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Verifies the OpenAPI schema returned by the FastAPI app

ctags.name: test
ctags.pattern: /^def test(path, headers, expected_status, expected_response, client: TestClient):$/
